svg.title: Two ways to touch
svg.desc: Two rows of equal-scale close-ups. In the first, two branches travel in the same direction and erase a little lens. In the second, opposite directions open a lens. White dots mark crossings. Arrows give actual travel direction.

g.text: A little space closes or opens between two regular, moving branches.
Direct touch · same travel direction · lens closes
Inverse touch · opposite directions · lens opens
Opening ∝ |weight offset| · length ∝ √|weight offset| · area ∝ |weight offset|³ᐟ²
Blue: earlier visit. Gold: later visit. Each row has equal coordinate scales and a fixed common-tangent frame.
Numerical drawings. Separate rational boxes certify eight selected touches and their local area coefficients.
